title: inspectEngagement response
description: inspectEngagement - responses per status code. ~1 min per-engagement downstream operation of the Engagements System, called by ms-publish-fanout under Bulkhead(C_max per cell) -> RateLimiter -> TimeLimiter(T_call) -> CircuitBreaker -> Retry(N_reint).
$comment: Source: DISENO S4 (a) 'inspect/classify' operation, (d) DownstreamEngagementClient, (g) idempotencyKey = jobId:engagementId:targetVersion (DEC-30), (h), (k) result (templateId, version); DISENO 4.8 SX-03; ADR-020 SX-03 + assumption on idempotency; ADR-010; E-51, E-34; SUP-08, OQ-05. Audience: CONSUMED CONTRACT (external system, client-side expectation) - SX-03 (S4 -> external downstream). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); only EngagementRef goes out and only (templateId, version) comes back (DISENO S4 (k)). Idempotency: expected idempotent per idempotencyKey (assumption SUP-08 b / OQ-05; if not, no automatic retry after timeout, ADR-020). Pagination: n/a. CONSUMED CONTRACT: owned by an external team; method, path, authentication and error bodies are NOT defined by the documents and are not designed here. Fallback: task -> RetryScheduled, logical DLQ.
